Across the board, front-seat side airbags have been added as standard equipment for all models. The flagship [Grand Cherokee](http://www.nadaguides.com/Cars/2014/Jeep/Grand-Cherokee "New 2014 Jeep Grand Cherokee Prices") receives a new 3.0-liter V6 engine with optional turbo-diesel, an eight-speed transmission and updates to the technology features.

The Compass gets a new six-speed automatic transmission, which replaces the CTV on most trim levels, and a flashy 6.5” touchscreen console in the Limited trim. The Patriot also gets a new six-speed transmission, and the [Wrangler](https://www.jdpower.com/Cars/Compare-Cars/2014-Jeep-Wrangler-vs-2014-Toyota-FJ-Cruiser "2014 Jeep Wrangler") and Wrangler Limited remain relatively unchanged.

Engine updates and feature upgrades were the primary theme for Volkswagen heading into 2014. A new 1.8-liter turbocharged four-cylinder debuted for the Beetle base model, while the Turbo model got 10 more horsepower.
